'''Sash Ketter''' was a [[human]] [[Gender|female]] [[New Republic pilot|pilot]] of the [[New Republic]]. She, along with [[pilot]]s [[Trapper Wolf]] and [[Jib Dodger]], was sent to follow a [[distress signal]] sent from the ''[[Bothan-5]]'', a [[New Republic Correctional Transport]], that had been infiltrated by [[Mercenary|mercenaries]]. Arriving at its location at a [[Roost|space station]] the three pilots identified a [[gunship]] being deployed and destroyed it, proceeding to fire on the [[space station]] after.

==Biography==
{{Dialogue|Jib Dodger|Yep. That's definitely a tracking beacon.|Trapper Wolf|Looks like they're launching a gunship.|Sash Ketter|Copy, going in.|attr=Jib Dodger, Trapper Wolf, and Sash Ketter|src=<ref name="Chapter 6" />}}
A hero of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic]],<ref name="CGttSWG" /> Sash Ketter was a [[New Republic pilot|pilot]] for the [[New Republic]]'s [[New Republic Starfighter Corps|Starfighter Corps]]. In [[9 ABY]],<ref name="Date">{{MandoDate|6}}</ref> She was part of a New Republic attack squadron known as the [[Adelphi Rangers]] with fellow [[pilot]]s [[Trapper Wolf]] and [[Jib Dodger]]. Their duties included locating certain active New Republic [[Homing beacon|tracking beacons]].<ref name="Chapter 6" />

[[File:X-WingsAttackingStation-Chapter6.png|thumb|left|250px|Ketter, Wolf, and Dodger attacked Malk's space station.]]
One such beacon was activated by the [[New Republic soldier]] [[Lieutenant]] [[Lant Davan]] when the ''[[Bothan-5]]'', a [[New Republic Correctional Transport]], he served on was [[Bothan-Five incident|infiltrated]] by several [[Mercenary|mercenaries]]. The beacon itself was then taken aboard the [[gunship]] ''[[Razor Crest]]'' and to a [[Roost|space station]] controlled by the criminal [[Ranzar Malk]]. Having followed the beacon, Ketter, Wolf and Dodger arrived before the [[space station]] on [[T-65B X-wing starfighter]]s, passing the ''Razor Crest'' after they exited [[hyperspace]]. Wolf confirmed the beacons signal and identified a gunship which was preparing to launch from one of the stations hangars. Although this gunship was targeting the ''Razor Crest'', Ketter and her squadron proceeded to fire on the hangar, destroying the ship. The trio then circled around station, firing on its exterior.<ref name="Chapter 6" />

Sometime later, Ketter was lounging in [[Adelphi Base]] together with Dodger and Wolf. They drank [[spotchka]] as they talked and relaxed.<ref name="Chapter 21">{{TheMandalorian|Chapter 21: The Pirate}}</ref>

==Personality and traits==
Sash Ketter was a [[human]] [[Gender|female]] who had tan skin, black [[hair]], and brown [[eye]]s.<ref name="Chapter 6" />

==Equipment==
Ketter wore an orange and white [[flight suit]] and a white [[K-22995 light flight helmet]] with blue and yellow markings and two New Republic roundels.<ref name="Chapter 6" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Ketter_Dodger_and_Wolf_MandoS3.png|thumb|right|275px|Ketter, Dodger, and Wolf lounge in Adelphi Base.]]
Sash Ketter first appeared in [[Chapter 6: The Prisoner|Chapter 6]] of the [[2019]] television series ''[[Star Wars: The Mandalorian]]'',<ref name="Chapter 6" /> which aired on [[December 13]], 2019,<ref name="DTCI">{{WebCite|url=https://lumiere-a.akamaihd.net/v1/documents/the_mandalorian_project_one-sheet_10_ec1e005f.pdf|text=The Mandalorian Media Kit|work=[https://dtcimedia.disney.com Disney Direct-to-Consumer & International]|archivedate=20230315011507}}</ref> portrayed by [[Deborah Chow]],<ref name="Chapter 6" /> the director of [[Chapter 3: The Sin|Chapter 3]]<ref name="Chapter 3">{{TheMandalorian|Chapter 3: The Sin}}</ref> and [[Chapter 7: The Reckoning|Chapter 7]] of the series.<ref name="Chapter 7">{{TheMandalorian|Chapter 7: The Reckoning}}</ref> Chow made her cameo appearance alongside<ref name="Chapter 6" /> fellow series directors<ref name="Blog">{{SW|url=news/the-mandalorian-revealed|text=''The Mandalorian'' First Image, Directors Revealed}}</ref> [[Dave Filoni]] and [[Rick Famuyiwa]], who portrayed Trapper Wolf and Jib Dodger respectively.<ref name="Chapter 6" /> According to [[Paul Sun-Hyung Lee]], who played the New Republic pilot [[Carson Teva]] in [[The Mandalorian Season Two|''The Mandalorian'' Season Two]], Chow had been suggested to reprise her role as Ketter alongside him in the Season Two episode "[[Chapter 10: The Passenger]]," but was replaced by Filoni as Wolf as Chow was busy with her show ''[[Star Wars: Obi-Wan Kenobi]]''.<ref name="SWE">{{YouTube|video=pX_vHoz_dMk|text=Paul Sun-Hyung Lee Is My New Best Friend - Comm Chatter #7|channel=@StarWarsExplained|name=Star Wars Explained|quote=Last week I sat down to talk Star Wars, cosplay, The Mandalorian, and general nerdiness with Carson Teva himself, Paul Sun-Hyung Lee!}}</ref>

In the [[The Mandalorian Season Three|third season]] of ''The Mandalorian'', Chow returned to cameo as the New Republic pilot again together with Famuyiwa and Filoni, but only as a background character with no speaking role.<ref name="Chapter 21" />
